CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Where do you place a soft shadow when painting a fruit on a table? (1 mark)
   A. On the ceiling
   B. Nowhere
   C. Inside the fruit
   D. On the table under the fruit

2. How can you fix sagging hips in the crab balance? (1 mark)
   A. Drop your head
   B. Push harder through your hands and feet
   C. Bend your arms
   D. Lie down

3. What is a spotter or supporting partner's job? (1 mark)
   A. To push you
   B. To laugh
   C. To leave
   D. To help gently as your teacher shows you

4. How high is the goal ring above the ground? (1 mark)
   A. 5 metres
   B. 1.5 metres
   C. 3.05 metres
   D. 10 metres

5. The basic knot for the macramé ball is the (1 mark)
   A. overhand knot
   B. reef knot
   C. sailor's knot
   D. fisherman's bend

6. How can you make the brightest part of a charcoal drawing? (1 mark)
   A. Leave the paper white or lift charcoal with a clean eraser
   B. Colour it black
   C. Press very hard
   D. Smudge with a wet cloth

7. In netball, the ball is moved mainly by (1 mark)
   A. rolling it
   B. running with it
   C. kicking it
   D. passing it

8. Pitch is (1 mark)
   A. how fast it is
   B. the words
   C. how high or low a note is
   D. how loud it is

9. The hare hop is done (1 mark)
   A. by hopping forward with both feet like a hare
   B. by crawling
   C. by rolling
   D. by sitting

10. In a crab balance, your body is supported by (1 mark)
   A. the head only
   B. the back only
   C. the knees and elbows
   D. both hands and both feet

11. A topical song is (1 mark)
   A. about the moon only
   B. about a topic that matters at a certain time
   C. always sad
   D. without a tune

12. A squeaky, very high sound usually means you are (1 mark)
   A. holding it upside down
   B. playing a drum
   C. blowing too hard
   D. blowing too gently

13. Which note is played with the thumb and holes 1 and 2 covered? (1 mark)
   A. D
   B. B
   C. G
   D. A

14. When someone comments on your work, you should (1 mark)
   A. tear the work
   B. walk away
   C. argue
   D. listen quietly and say thank you

15. In music, the sign f means (1 mark)
   A. soft
   B. silent
   C. loud
   D. slow

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain how to make a tint of blue. (2 marks)

17. Explain the difference between a sacred song and a patriotic song. (3 marks)

18. Give three hygiene rules for the pool. (3 marks)

19. What is a false start? (2 marks)

20. State three points of good sprinting technique. (3 marks)

21. When is an overhead pass better than a chest pass? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — On the table under the fruit
   A shadow under the object makes it seem to sit on the table.

2. B — Push harder through your hands and feet
   Pushing through hands and feet lifts the hips.

3. D — To help gently as your teacher shows you
   A partner supports carefully and only in the way taught.

4. C — 3.05 metres
   The netball goal ring is 3.05 metres high.

5. A — overhand knot
   The learner uses overhand knots to make the net around the core.

6. A — Leave the paper white or lift charcoal with a clean eraser
   The brightest parts have little or no charcoal.

7. D — passing it
   Players may not run with the ball, so they pass it to move it forward.

8. C — how high or low a note is
   Accurate pitch means singing the right notes.

9. A — by hopping forward with both feet like a hare
   Small quick hops.

10. D — both hands and both feet
   A crab balance rests on two hands and two feet.

11. B — about a topic that matters at a certain time
   Topical songs give messages about topics such as health, safety or the environment.

12. C — blowing too hard
   Gentle air makes a good tone.

13. D — A
   A uses thumb, 1 and 2.

14. D — listen quietly and say thank you
   Good listeners grow.

15. C — loud
   The letter f stands for loud.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Add white to blue, a little at a time, until it is as light as you want.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for white, 1 mark for adding gradually.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: A sacred song is a song of worship that praises God. A patriotic song shows love for the country, such as the national anthem.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning, 1 mark for an example.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Shower before and after; do not spit or pass urine in the pool; do not drink the water; dry yourself and change into dry clothes. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Leaving the start line before the last signal is given.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for leaving early, 1 mark for before the signal.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Eyes look ahead; elbows bent and arms swing back and forth; knees lift high; land on the front of the foot; body leans forward slightly. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: When a defender stands close so that the ball must go over their arms.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a defender, 1 mark for going over.
